title: CloudWatch from C#
description: Send custom metrics, logs, and alarms from an ASP.NET Core app to CloudWatch.

data.text: The `AWSSDK.CloudWatch` package lets you publish custom metrics and log events programmatically. You can also use the ASP.NET Core logging provider to send logs to CloudWatch Logs automatically.

data.title: Track a custom metric
data.content: Use `AmazonCloudWatchClient` to publish metrics. Includes a service class with error handling, cancellation token, and expected output comments.

data.text: You can use the CloudWatch Logs SDK directly, or use an ASP.NET Core logging provider to route `ILogger` messages to CloudWatch.

data.title: Structured logging for CloudWatch Logs Insights
data.content: Use structured message templates so you can filter in CloudWatch Logs Insights. Includes try/catch and expected output comments.

data.title: Create an alarm for high CPU
data.content:
Use the AWS CLI to create an alarm that triggers when CPU exceeds 80%.
# Expected output: Alarm is created and transitions to OK state.
data.code: aws cloudwatch put-metric-alarm --alarm-name aspnet-high-cpu --alarm-description "CPU exceeds 80%" --metric-name CPUUtilization --namespace AWS/ElasticBeanstalk --statistic Average --period 300 --threshold 80 --comparison-operator GreaterThanThreshold --evaluation-periods 2 --alarm-actions arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:aspnet-alerts

data.title: Add custom metrics and alarms
data.description: Instrument an existing API with CloudWatch metrics and alarms.
steps: Create a CloudWatch namespace for your app
Publish a custom metric when a post is created
Create an alarm that triggers when the error rate exceeds a threshold
Subscribe an email address to the alarm SNS topic
data.expectedOutcome: Custom metrics appear in CloudWatch and alarms trigger notifications.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Structured logging makes CloudWatch queries more powerful
Alarms notify you when metrics cross thresholds
SNS integrates with CloudWatch alarms for email and SMS alerts
data.takeaway: CloudWatch turns an ASP.NET Core app into an observable system with minimal code changes.
